notes.title: 1BITDRAGON 4.3 is released today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41742887/0f3e5630e265db9a7583daa8bd21149db2e572b1.gif[/img]

[h3]Improved note editing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] click: Create note          
[*] click+alt: Create attenuated note          
[*] click+shift: Paint notes          
[*] click+ctrl and drag:  Copy note          
[*] right click: Delete note          
[*] click and drag: Move note          
[*] click and drag at the ends: Change the length of a note        
[/list]  
[h3]Move around the window when zoomed-in by pressing the middle mouse button or the M key while moving the mouse[/h3]

[h3]Turn "pixel-perfect" mode on/off (i.e. Draw monophonically without allowing multiple notes in the same column) with the P key[/h3]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

https://1bitdragon.com/V4.3.gif

notes.title: 1BITDRAGON 4
notes.notes:
New features:
	- Control over note length (shift+click)
	- Full scale (not just pentatonic)
	- Recording of mp3 files
	- Recording of flac files
